messages:
sara: Heads-up — we need to run the prod DB migration for feature/long-tail-index tonight. This requires the prod-custodian role and a pinned migration image. Who can be custodian and approve JIT?
aj: I can act as custodian but need DB-owner approval + MFA. What's the pinned image SHA?
dmitri: I can approve the JIT. migration image should be pinned to `gcr.redwood-inference.com/releases/2026-03-20@sha256:7f3b9a12`. Deploy-bot will reject unpinned images.
olivia: Also request a maintenance window 22:00-23:00 UTC and add a rollback play in release notes. I'll watch metrics.
sara: +1 on window. Aj, can you request JIT via `/request-elev` and include reason "db migration + custodian"? Deploy-bot enforces the custodian label.
deploy-bot: NOTICE: Preflight check failed — missing role `prod-custodian`. Run `/request-elev --role prod-custodian --reason "db migration" --expires 2h`. See runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/db-migrations
aj: Requested JIT at 21:45, included the pinned SHA and link to release notes. MFA step prompted.
dmitri: Approved the JIT request at 21:47. MFA confirmed. Remember to pin the migration manifest to avoid accidental drift.
sara: Migration plan uploaded to the release doc and release-notes: `2026-03-20-db-migration.md`. I added the rollback steps: snapshot, `pg_restore`, and traffic cutback commands.
olivia: Quick checklist I added to the doc: pre-checks, pg snapshot, run migration in canary shard, validate reads, promote. If any latency > 30% or error rate spike, abort and rollback.
oncall: Setting pager thresholds and will escalate to oncall if replication lag > 60s.
deploy-bot: Deploy policy check: image pinned ✅, JIT approved ✅, maintenance window flagged ✅. Ready to press. Use `/deploy --image <pinned-sha> --tag 2026.03.20-db --migration`
aj: Pressing deploy at 22:05. Rolling out to canary shards now.
sara: Monitoring dashboard open. Olivia on metrics, Dmitri on DB approval, I'll coordinate rollback if needed.
olivia: Canary looks healthy at +5min. CPU steady, queries within thresholds.
sara: Proceeding to full rollout.
olivia: Saw a small spikes at +17min, but within SLO. Continuing.
sara: Finalize release note: added note about custodian flow and MFA steps. Tagging this thread in the release channel for audit. :white_check_mark:
dmitri: Thanks team — custodian access audit will log this approval. If we need to revert, follow rollback steps in the doc.
aj: All done — closing JIT and rotating the temporary key.
sara: Closing thread — migration completed, no rollback required.
